method_name: Demonstrate that a relation-free hierarchical graph (Tri-Graph) with lightweight construction and a two-stage retrieval approach (entity activation via semantic bridging + global importance aggregation via PageRank) can outperform graph-based RAG methods while achieving linear scalability and zero LLM token cost during indexing.
method_goal: Describe only the code-supported claims in the authoring projection.
implementation_scope: /data1/users/cuihengjia/code2paper/code_final/LinearRAG - Linear Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation on Large-scale Corpora

stages.name: Offline Graph Construction
stages.purpose: Offline Graph Construction: Build a Tri‑Graph from the corpus by splitting passages into sentences, extracting entities with spaCy, and creating sparse contain (passage–entity) and mention (sentence–entity) adjacency matrices.

mechanisms.description: Offline Graph Construction: Build a Tri‑Graph from the corpus by splitting passages into sentences, extracting entities with spaCy, and creating sparse contain (passage–entity) and mention (sentence–entity) adjacency matrices.

stages.name: Entity Activation via Local Semantic Bridging
stages.purpose: Entity Activation via Local Semantic Bridging: For a query, activate relevant entities by initializing from matched entities, computing query–sentence similarities, and iteratively propagating scores through the sentence–entity subgraph with dynamic pruning to discover hidden bridging entities.
